source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The mail/base/test/unit head now only initializes the profile. test_migrateTryStartTLS.js and test_qrExport.js import MailServices themselves; unused shared imports and the directory-wide mailShutdown cleanup are removed. The bug links this setup to a permanent test failure, while review reports that the repair works. This supports the dependency split in this test directory. It is not a blanket rule against shared heads or cleanup hooks. No test was executed here.
title: Move test-only dependencies out of a shared head when only a few tests use them
